title: JLab JBuds Talk USB Microphone White (with code JLABWOOT)

comparisons.notes: JBuds Talk USB Microphone White, brand store, in stock at $99.99 (Woot Asin B0BFL1S9FP is the White JBuds Talk)

writeup: JLab's JBuds Talk USB mic is new on Woot for $24.99, and code JLABWOOT takes another $5 off to $19.99 (new customers save $10). It records at 96kHz/24-bit with four pickup patterns, gain and quick mute, plus a 3.5mm monitoring jack. JLab's own store sells it for $99.99.
amazon_match_notes: Woot page Asin B0BFL1S9FP; Amazon title 'JLab JBuds Talk USB-C Microphone ... White' matches product
